title: Menene ma'anar A1, A2, B1, B2, C1 da C2?
invitation: Waɗannan ƙananan lambobin mataki suna bayyana a littattafai, darussa, jarabawa, manhajoji da bayanan harshe a duniya. Ga abin da suke nufi, dalilin da matakinka zai iya bambanta tsakanin ƙwarewa, da yadda Gef ke amfani da su.
summary: Gef yana amfani da CEFR A1–C2 a matsayin taswirar gama gari ta ƙwarewar harshe, yana riƙe Pre-A1 don matakan farko, kuma yana ƙara Cikakken iya magana / Matakin ɗan asalin harshe sama da C2. Ƙwarewarka na iya bambanta a karatu, sauraro, magana, rubutu, mu'amala da shiga tsakani.

blocks.title: Taswira ɗaya ta ƙwarewar harshe
blocks.text: A1 zuwa C2 sun fito daga Common European Framework of Reference for Languages, CEFR. Yana ba ɗalibai, malamai, makarantu, jarabawa da masu wallafa hanya ɗaya ta bayyana ƙwarewar harshe daga sadarwa ta asali zuwa amfani mai 'yanci, sassauƙa da daidaito. A da B ba maki na makaranta ba ne, kuma Gef ba ya ɗauka cewa duk harsuna suna da hanya ɗaya ta ƙamus ko nahawu.

blocks.title: Pre-A1 · Matakan farko
blocks.text: Pre-A1 shi ne kafin A1. Kana iya gane wasu kalmomi, alamomi, sautuka, sunaye, lambobi ko jimlolin da aka haddace amma har yanzu kana buƙatar taimako sosai. CEFR na zamani yana da Pre-A1. A ma'aunin Gef mai sauƙi, tsakiya yana nufin babu ilimi kuma zobe na farko shi ne A1.

blocks.title: A1 · Mafari
blocks.text: A A1 kana iya yin abubuwa masu amfani da ɗan harshe a batutuwa da yanayi na yau da kullum. Kana fahimtar gajeren abu mai sauƙi kuma kana musayar bayanai na asali. Zuwa A2 yana nufin rage dogaro da jimlolin haddacewa da iya ƙarin yanayi na yau da kullum.

blocks.title: A2 · Rayuwar yau da kullum
blocks.text: A A2 rayuwar yau da kullum tana fara zama mai sauƙin tafiyarwa da harshen: mutane, wurare, ayyuka, aiki ko makaranta, sayayya, tafiya, lokaci da buƙatun gaggawa. Zuwa B1 yana nufin haɗa ra'ayoyi, bayyana sauƙaƙan dalilai da fuskantar yanayi marasa tabbas sosai.

blocks.title: B1 · Mai zaman kansa
blocks.text: A B1 kana iya tafiyar da yawancin yanayi ba tare da shirya kowace jimla ba. Kana bin babban ma'anar harshe mai bayyana kuma kana magana game da gogewa, tsare-tsare, ra'ayi da matsaloli. Zuwa B2 yana nufin ƙara faɗi, daki-daki, sauri da iko.

blocks.title: B2 · Ƙarfi mai zaman kansa
blocks.text: A B2 kana iya shiga doguwar sadarwa yadda ya dace, tattauna ra'ayoyi na zahiri da na tunani, da aiki a yanayi na zamantakewa, ilimi da sana'a. Zuwa C1 yana nufin ƙarin iko kan ma'ana mai ɓoye, salo, tsari da register.

blocks.title: C1 · Babban mataki
blocks.text: A C1 harshe yana zama kayan aiki mai sassauci. Kana iya sarrafa abu mai wahala, fahimtar ma'anar da ba a faɗa kai tsaye ba, da daidaita sauti da salo da yanayi. Zuwa C2 ya fi shafar zurfi, bambance-bambance masu laushi, sake faɗa da sauri, fannoni na musamman da iko mai daidaito.

blocks.title: C2 · Ƙwarewa mai matuƙar girma
blocks.text: C2 shi ne mafi girman matakin CEFR na gama gari. Mai C2 yana iya sarrafa harshe mai wahala sosai da kyakkyawan iko kan ma'ana, tsari, abin da ake nufi da salo. C2 ba yana nufin sanin kowace kalma, rashin kuskure ko zama ɗan asalin harshe kai tsaye ba.

blocks.title: Cikakken iya magana / Matakin ɗan asalin harshe · Mafi girman zaɓin Gef
blocks.text: Gef yana ƙara nasa mataki sama da C2: Cikakken iya magana / Matakin ɗan asalin harshe. Ba CEFR C3 ba ne ko takardar shaida ta hukuma. Wanda ba ɗan asalin harshe ba ma zai iya zaɓa idan ainihin ƙwarewarsa ta yi daidai da balagaggen ɗan asalin harshe mai cikakken iya magana. Gef yana bayyana iyawa, ba asali ba.

blocks.title: Ƙwarewar harsheka siffa ce, ba harafi ɗaya ba
blocks.text: Ginshikai shida na iya bambanta: Karatu, Sauraro, Magana, Rubutu, Mu'amala da Shiga tsakani. Kana iya zama C1 a karatu, B2 a sauraro da A2 a magana. Taswirar radar mai ginshiƙai shida tana nuna bambance-bambancen maimakon mayar da su lamba ɗaya.

blocks.title: Mataki ba jerin duk darussan baya ba ne
blocks.text: Koyon harshe ba ya tafiya daidai. Kana iya rasa wani ƙa'idar nahawu ta asali amma ka kasance da ƙwarewa mai girma a wani wuri. Gef ya kamata ya bayyana tsarin abin da kake iya yi gaba ɗaya, ba ya ɗauka cewa B2 na nufin ka gama duk A1 da A2 daidai ba.

blocks.title: Gef yanzu yana auna karatu, ba duk hexagon ɗinka ba
blocks.text: Gef yanzu manhaja ce mai fifita karatu. Kana iya bayar da ƙimar kanka a duk ƙwarewa shida, amma shaida daga littattafai, darussan karatu, fahimta da amfani da ƙamus ya kamata ta shafi ƙimar Karatu kawai. Gef bai kamata ya ƙiyasta Magana, Sauraro, Rubutu, Mu'amala ko Shiga tsakani daga karatu ba.

blocks.title: Littafin A2 yana bayyana littafin
blocks.text: A2 a kan littafi alama ce ta wahalar karatu. Kammala littafin shaida ce game da karatu, amma ba ta tabbatar da cewa duk sauran ƙwarewa ma A2 ba ne. Haka ma jarabawa: duba abin da aka auna a gaske.

blocks.title: Menene shiga tsakani?
blocks.text: Shiga tsakani yana nufin taimaka wa ma'ana ta ketare wani gibi. Ya haɗa da fassara, tafsirin kai tsaye, taƙaita rubutu mai wahala, bayyana da harshe mai sauƙi, isar da bayani tsakanin mutanen da ba su da harshe ɗaya, da sake tsara rashin jituwa don bangarorin su fahimci juna.

blocks.title: Ci gaban kwas na iya ba da alama
blocks.text: Wasu manhajoji suna wallafa alaƙar kwas ɗinsu da CEFR. A Duolingo Score, 0–29 A1 ne, 30–59 A2, 60–99 B1, 100–129 B2, kuma 130–160 ya rufe C1/C2 a ma'aunin kwas. Wannan ci gaban kwas ne, ba hujja mai zaman kanta cewa duk ƙwarewa suna mataki ɗaya ba, don haka Gef yana riƙe asalin maki a matsayin shaida ɗaya.

blocks.title: Duniya tana da tsarin matakan harshe da yawa
blocks.text: CEFR ba shi kaɗai ba ne. Akwai ACTFL a ilimin harshe na Amurka, ILR 0–5 a wasu mahallan gwamnatin Amurka, CLB/NCLC a Kanada, JLPT N5–N1 ga Jafananci da HSK ga Mandarin. Manufarsu ta bambanta, don haka Gef bai ɗauka cewa kowane lakabi yana da cikakkiyar daidaituwa ɗaya-da-ɗaya ba.

blocks.title: Misali: JLPT na Jafananci
blocks.text: Daga Disamba 2025, sakamakon JLPT da aka ci na iya nuna matakin CEFR na hukuma bisa matakin JLPT da jimillar maki. Amma JLPT yana auna ilimin harshe, karatu da sauraro, ba magana, rubutu ko mu'amala ba. Saboda haka mapping ya kamata ya shafi ƙwarewar da aka auna kawai.

blocks.title: HSK na Sinanci yana canzawa, don haka sigar tana da muhimmanci
blocks.text: HSK jarabawar Mandarin ce ta ma'auni. HSK 2.0 tana da matakai shida da alaƙar tarihi da CEFR. Sabuwar HSK 3.0 an tsara ta da matakai uku da ƙananan matakai tara, amma aiwatarwar 2026 har yanzu tana canji. Gef yana adana sigar HSK kuma yana ɗaukar juyar matakai tara zuwa CEFR a matsayin ƙiyasta har sai an fitar da daidaituwar hukuma.

blocks.title: Tsari ba daidai yake da jarabawa ba
blocks.text: CEFR tsari ne na bayyana ƙwarewa. Jarabawa da ƙungiyoyi suna iya daidaita sakamakonsu da shi. Maki yana buƙatar mahalli: wace ƙwarewa aka auna, yadda aka yi daidaitawa, lokacin da aka yi, da ko sakamakon na hukuma ne ko ƙiyasta. Gef bai kamata ya kira ƙiyastarsa takardar CEFR ta hukuma ba.

blocks.title: Babu adadin kalmomin A2 guda ɗaya ga duk harsuna
blocks.text: Ƙamus yana da muhimmanci, amma CEFR ba ya bayyana A1, A2 ko B1 da adadin kalmomi guda ɗaya. Harsuna suna bambanta a rarraba kalma, rubutu, kalmomin haɗe, morphology da tsara ma'ana. Ƙiyastar ƙamus ta Turanci ba za a kwafe ta kai tsaye zuwa duk sauran harsuna ba.

blocks.title: Yadda Gef ke amfani da matakai
blocks.text: Gef yana amfani da CEFR A1–C2 a matsayin ma'auni na gama gari, Pre-A1 don matakan farko, da nasa Cikakken iya magana / Matakin ɗan asalin harshe a sama. Littattafai suna da wahalar karatu kuma bayanan mai koyo na iya riƙe ƙimomin ƙwarewa shida. Alamar mataki na iya buɗe sashen darasin da ya dace, yayin da bayanan manhajar kowane harshe ke bayyana ra'ayoyi, ma'anar kalmomi, nahawu, rubutu da nau'ikan rubutu dabam.

blocks.title: Gefstimate ƙiyasta ce, ba difloma ba
blocks.text: Idan Gef ya haɗa shaidu masu maimaituwa nan gaba, UI na Turanci na iya kiran ƙiyastar Gefstimate. Ba za a tilasta wasa da kalmar ga sauran harsuna ba. Ƙiyasta ce mai tushen shaida don takamaiman ƙwarewa, ba takardar CEFR ta hukuma ba, kuma Gef ya kamata ya iya bayyana shaidar da aka yi amfani da ita.

blocks.title: Ta yaya kake hawa mataki na gaba?
blocks.text: Ba ta hanyar cike mashaya ci gaba guda ɗaya ba. Ƙiyastar Gef ta gaba za ta iya haɗa aikin darasi, wahalar abin da ka karanta cikin nasara, taimakon da kake buƙata, sakamakon fahimta da sauran shaidun da suka dace da ƙwarewar. Ƙamus da nahawu suna taimakawa amma ba su ne ƙofa guda ɗaya ba. Littafi mai sauƙi guda ɗaya bai kamata ya ɗaga mataki kai tsaye ba kuma rana mai wahala guda ɗaya bai kamata ta saukar ba; rabon mataki na atomatik da adaptive testing kayan more rayuwa ne na gaba.

blocks.title: A taƙaice
blocks.description: Sifili yana nufin babu ilimi tukuna. Pre-A1 matakan farko ne. A1 da A2 suna gina ƙwarewar yau da kullum. B1 da B2 suna nuna ƙarin 'yanci. C1 da C2 ƙwarewa ce mai girma, sassauƙa da daidaito. Gef sai ya ƙara Cikakken iya magana / Matakin ɗan asalin harshe a matsayin nasa mafi girman mataki. Ƙwarewarka ta gaskiya ita ce siffar ginshiƙai shida na abin da kake iya yi.
